Lon van Ettinger | Ray-marching full screen volumetric fog
In this article I'll be discussing the basic concepts of ray-marching and volumetric fog in real-time graphics and implementing a full-screen volumetric fog effect using ray-marching. My implementation will use OpenGL for rendering and GLSL shader code.
